attributes.board_name: Georgia State Board of Veterinary Medicine

rules.accepted_credit_types: Blanket approval: national, state and international veterinary association meetings; USDA and Georgia Dept. of Agriculture meetings; AVMA-recognized specialty boards; AVMA-accredited veterinary schools; AAVSB RACE; GVMA constituent organizations; AAHA; US/Southern Animal Health Association; courses approved by another state board. LEAP courses need Board approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in the first year of a biennium: 15 hours (no LEAP needed); licensed in the second year: exempt for that renewal.

topics.who: Georgia laws, rules and professionalism (LEAP); not required for licensees who do not practice in Georgia

rules.notes: At least 18 h scientific. Max 15 h non-interactive computer courses and 3 h journal study (with testing); max 6 h in-house training; max 12 h per day. CE must be recorded in CE Broker before renewal.
